text: e& (Emirates Telecommunications Group, the rebranded Etisalat) is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (EIA), which the company's own corporate governance report calls the Government Shareholder.
short: e& is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (UAE federal government)

source.name: e& (Etisalat Group): Corporate Governance Report 2019, board and shareholding sections (PDF)
source.quote: The Government Shareholder (Emirates Investment Authority “EIA” or any other body constituted as government representative in the Company
source.note: The same report's shareholder table lists Emirates Investment Authority (EIA) with 60% ('shareholders holding 5% and above of Etisalat total shares'). The 2022 integrated annual report repeats that the Federal Government transferred its 60% holding to EIA 'with effect from 1 January 2008' and that EIA is 'ultimately controlled by the UAE Federal Government' (integrated-report-en-2022-1.pdf, notes to the financial statements — that PDF exceeds the 8 MB a script fetches).

additionalSources.name: AGBI (Arabian Gulf Business Insight): Etisalat / e& company profile (undated, opened 29 September 2026)
additionalSources.quote: The ownership structure changed in 1983 when the UAE government held a 60% share. The remainder is publicly traded
